messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — I'm creating a tiny kanban for remediation items. Need clear owners + timelines for rollout/canary fixes: auto-rollback, flag scope defaults, blast-radius caps. Can people call dibs?
aj: I can own the auto-rollback policy proposal. I’ll put a draft up by EOD Friday.
devon: I’ll take blast-radius defaults and flag scoping. Proposal: default 5% per-flag, ramp steps documented. Will open RFC + PR.
sam: Noted recurring pattern: incidents spike when new flags go 100% immediately. Suggest default new flags to 1% with automatic ramp to 10% after a stability window. We also need telemetry that detects regressions during ramps.
claire: For tracking, I’ll create the Kanban board + tickets tagged postmortem-remediation and add owners. Weekly one-line sync on Friday.
maria: Thanks. Please paste PR/JIRA links here when you create them. Also call out any infra perms needed for canary timer changes.
aj: Quick config sketch for auto-rollback I’ll prototype in staging:
```
auto_rollback:
  enabled: true
  error_threshold: 5% # rolling per-minute threshold
  sampling_window: 2m
  fallback_policy: fallback-to-smaller-model
```
Will wire this into the canary controller.
devon: For rollout ramps I propose an enforced ramp template: blast_radius: 1% -> 5% -> 25% with guards on step duration and a max-absolute-user cap. Will include CLI defaults.
sam: I’ll add metric-based alerts: if canary_error_rate > 3% for 3 consecutive mins -> trigger automated rollback AND page oncall. Also adding regression fingerprinting so we can cluster recurring failures.
deploy-bot: Deployment triggered: canary-config-prototype -> staging by aj (build #4521).
aj: Staging tests green. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1234 — feedback welcome.
claire: Tickets created: RD-9876 (auto-rollback RFC), RD-9877 (flag blast radius defaults + ramp), RD-9878 (kanban + owner list). Owners added and initial due dates set.
maria: Current timeline check: aj draft by EOD Fri (RD-9876), devon RFC next Wed (RD-9877), sam alerts by next Tue (RD-9879), claire to keep the board updated. If blocked, call it out here.
devon: Adding a mitigation for the recurring class "KV cache growth -> model overload". Will propose eviction + memory watermark and add telemetry breakpoints.
sam: Also let's schedule a 15-min validation on Monday to exercise the STAGING rollback with injected error spikes. @maria @aj @devon please attend.
maria: :thumbsup: added to calendar. Thanks — keep updates in this thread and link PRs/JIRAs as they land.
